Sun.notes: Core identity. Depth, truth, transformation, magnetism, emotional intensity.

Moon.notes: Emotional body. Safety, home, cyclical energy, nurturing, deep feeling memory.

Mercury.notes: Thinking mind. Depth-seeking, research-driven, precise, pattern-reading, truth-hungry.

Venus.notes: Love & style. Loyal, steady, quality-minded, slow-building commitment, shows love through consistent actions, values what lasts.

Mars.notes: Drive & action. Beauty-motivated, conflict-careful, decisive through values, aesthetics as fuel.

Jupiter.notes: Expansion. Growth through communication, curiosity, ideas, learning, and many interests.

Saturn.notes: Discipline. Slow wealth, body stability, patience, practical foundations, calm spending.

Uranus.notes: Awakening. Innovation, community, collective consciousness, futurist thinking.

Neptune.notes: Dreams. Collective imagination, spiritual dissolution, idealism, mass consciousness.

Pluto.notes: Transformation. Generational power, belief system death/rebirth, philosophy as power.

NNode.notes: Soul direction. Toward emotional intelligence, home, receiving, intuition, nurturing others.

SNode.notes: Past patterns. Releasing over-achievement, proving, rigid control, cold ambition.

Chiron.notes: Wound & healing. Belief systems, freedom, teaching before being taught, philosophical pain.

Lilith.notes: Raw power. Wild mind, rebellion through voice, refusing to be silenced or simplified.

Midheaven.notes: Career & legacy. Analyst, helper, systems-builder, clarity-giver, service through craft.

Rising.notes: First impression. Quick, expressive, communicative, multi-faceted, youthful energy.
